verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only a structured CLI (tofu plan, test, import), declarative HCL configuration, and machine-readable JSON output. Nothing shows the product accepting or interpreting natural-language commands. Operating a tool via natural language is a fair axis for an infrastructure-as-code tool, so absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
